items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I'll have the salad.
items.explanation: Review (Unit 4): der Salat is masculine and the object: den Salat.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I have to work tomorrow.
items.explanation: Review (Unit 3): ich muss, and arbeiten at the end.

items.question: Which word means 'boss'?
items.explanation: der Chef, die Chefin = the boss. der Kunde = customer.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: I still have to send the email.
items.explanation: schicken = to send. After muss, the verb goes to the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap with beginnen: What time does the class start?
items.text: Um wie viel Uhr ___ der Kurs?
items.explanation: der Kurs beginnt. beginnen is not separable.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Please write the answer. (polite)
items.explanation: Sie form: the verb first, then Sie.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Listen! (to a friend)
items.explanation: du hörst zu becomes Hör zu! The separable part stays at the end.

items.instruction: Fill in the gap: Take the book! (to a friend)
items.explanation: du nimmst becomes Nimm! The vowel change stays.

items.question: Which is the polite way to say 'Please close the door'?
items.explanation: Sie form: Schließen Sie. Schließ! is for a friend, Schließt! for a group of friends.

items.text: Kreuzen Sie an: richtig oder falsch?
items.explanation: ankreuzen is separable: Kreuzen Sie ... an. richtig = right, falsch = wrong.

items.instruction: A new colleague starts tomorrow and asks you what to do. Write 3-4 instructions or tips for their first day, with du or Sie: when to come, what to do first, who to call. Use the imperative (Komm ..., Lies ..., Ruf ... an). Claude will check it.
